title: I/O Traits
summary: Traits like Read, Write, and BufRead for abstract byte input and output.
lecture: Rust abstracts over data sources and sinks using the Read and Write traits from `std::io`.
Types implementing Read supply bytes into caller-provided buffers, while Write accepts bytes from callers.
BufRead adds buffered reading capabilities, enabling line-by-line iteration over any input stream.

example.caption: Read operates on mutable buffers.
